# Governance

pqscan ships under the
[MIT licence](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/LICENSE).
This page is the governance map: decision records, signing identity,
supply-chain posture, and the verification commands.

## Architecture Decision Records

Structured decisions live in the repository:
[`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/tree/main/docs/adr) — accepted
records are immutable, superseded only by newer ones.

| Record | Decision | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [ADR-0001](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-adopt-go-over-rust.md) | Adopt Go (crypto/tls + uTLS + quic-go) over Rust; measured re-validation | accepted |
| [ADR-0002](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-watched-red-merge-gate.md) | Watched RED: test-first as the merge gate; evidence verbatim in PR bodies + issue comments | accepted |
| [ADR-0003](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-slsa-provenance-attestations.md) | SLSA provenance for every artifact via GitHub Artifact Attestations; unsigned release binaries are release-blockers | accepted |

## Commit signing

Every commit and tag is GPG-signed;
[key `9CB1781DC2BB28D37A0155DCAAF8226F3F4C1712`](https://github.com/shsingh.gpg)
(`shain.singh@owasp.org`, GitHub-verified). The
[`protect-default` ruleset](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/rules/25139149)
enforces `required_signatures` — unsigned commits block the PR — plus
PR-only merges with code-owner review and required CI checks
(`build`, `test`, dependency review, PR title gate, site-check).

## Supply chain: SLSA provenance and attestation

Every artifact the CI produces carries **SLSA build provenance** generated
keylessly in-job by [GitHub Artifact Attestations](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-for-github-actions/using-artifact-attestations/using-artifact-attestations-to-establish-provenance-for-builds)
([ADR-0003](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-slsa-provenance-attestations.md)):
Sigstore-signed, bound to this repository's OID issuer, published to the
public attestation log.

Verify any artifact before running it:

```bash
gh attestation verify pqscan-linux-amd64 -R shsingh/pqscan
```

The verification contract: the artifact's digest must match a provenance
record whose repository and workflow identity resolve to
`shsingh/pqscan`; anything unsigned or unprovable is not distributed.

## Automated posture

| Control | Status |
|---|---|
| Secret scanning + push protection | enabled (repo settings) |
| Dependabot security updates + alerts | enabled |
| Dependency Review on every PR | active (`dependency-review.yml`) |
| OpenSSF Scorecard (SARIF + public results) | weekly (`scorecards.yml`) |
| Artifact attestations (SLSA provenance) | on every push to `main` touching Go sources (`attest.yml`) |
| Branch ruleset (signatures, PR-only, checks) | active (`protect-default`) |

## Contributor surfaces

- [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — contributors + coding agents (conventions AND the run/execute runbook).
- [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) — the working agreement (Conventional Commits, one logical change per PR).
- [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/SECURITY.md) — vulnerability reporting policy.
- [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) — community contract.
